description:
List districts

Districts (roughly 960 nationwide) with pharmacy and on-duty counts, optionally filtered to one city. A district's `id` is its name; `cityId` is its city's. Not paged: the whole list in one answer.

GET /v1/pharmacy/districts on Nöbetçi Eczane (SBX-ECZ). Costs 0 credits per call.

city.description: Restrict to districts of this city (case- and accent-insensitive). Omit to list all districts nationwide.
